scope: Independent offline staged dataset transaction, file verification, commit recovery, and asynchronous Build interpretation
acceptance_understood: Read staged file metadata and content before commit, using both transaction range bounds.
Verify COMMITTED transaction, branch pointer, and same-branch file metadata/content after commit.
Interpret RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CANCELED, and bounded pending separately.
Reconcile upload or commit timeout before deciding whether replay is safe.
Preserve evidence and leave independent grading and ticket disposition to another agent.

choices.identity: Synthetic UserTokenAuth, synthetic host/RIDs/branch/path; authorized metadata and resource permission remain prerequisites for live work.
choices.version: Root FoundryClient public v2 routes; prepared SDK 1.101.0.
choices.transaction: APPEND on explicitly named reader-j12 branch; one staged CSV path, explicit transaction RID for upload.
choices.views: Before commit, start_transaction_rid=end_transaction_rid=known RID. After commit, branch_name=reader-j12.
choices.build: Separately call Build.create with ManualTarget(target_rids=[synthetic dataset RID]); submission RUNNING remains incomplete.
choices.concurrency: Synthetic fixture has one writer. Read reconciliation does not establish an atomic compare-and-set guarantee under concurrent external writers.
choices.expected: Only SUCCEEDED produces success; other terminal statuses unsuccessful; exhausted budget pending.

code_config.journal: Journal atomically replaces JSON in own directory after flush/fsync, recording intent before mutations and known RIDs afterward. Resume loads and validates dataset/branch/path/payload hash.
code_config.expected: No SDK automatic retry or duplicate create; finite upload/commit/poll work.

validation.method: Own stateful httpx.MockTransport invokes real SDK root client serializers and result decoders. Own service asserts exact method/path/query/body, selected header semantics, auth presence, finite timeout, stage/branch state, and mutation ordering.
validation.requests: Per-case trace JSON preserves timestamp, method, path, query, non-secret headers, body, timeout, response/transport exception. Synthetic Authorization is checked but omitted from evidence.
validation.network: DNS getaddrinfo, socket.connect, and socket.connect_ex patched to deny during execution; explicit DNS/public-IP connection probes each rejected in every case.
validation.expected: 12 scenario outcomes and mutation counts match; corruption/branch faults halt before build submission.
validation.actual: Exit 0. Twelve scenarios matched expected outcomes. 24 explicit denial probes rejected; mock transport provided every SDK response.
validation.limits: No tenant deployment, OAuth exchange, transform execution, or live permissions checked. Deadline-exhaustion timing, lost create response, abort timeout, and arbitrary concurrent writer behavior are not exercised.

expected_actual.success: RUNNING then SUCCEEDED -> success; actual success after 2 reads.
expected_actual.failed: RUNNING then FAILED -> unsuccessful; actual unsuccessful after 2 reads.
expected_actual.canceled: RUNNING then CANCELED -> unsuccessful; actual unsuccessful after 2 reads.
expected_actual.pending: RUNNING for 3 reads -> pending; actual pending, known RID retained.
expected_actual.upload_recovery: Upload takes effect then loses reply -> verify staged view, continue; actual one upload attempt/effect.
expected_actual.commit_recovery: Commit takes effect then loses reply -> reconcile transaction+branch; actual one commit attempt/effect.
expected_actual.commit_safe_retry: First commit times out without effect -> reconcile OPEN+original branch+staged bytes, retry once; actual two requests, one commit effect.
expected_actual.pending_resume: Reload journal and re-read retained build after pending; actual success with unchanged mutation list.
expected_actual.staging_corruption: Mismatch -> abort confirmed OPEN transaction, no commit/build; actual stopped, one abort.
expected_actual.visible_corruption: Postcommit mismatch -> stop, no build/replay; actual stopped with committed transaction retained.
expected_actual.branch_mismatch: Wrong branch pointer -> stop, no build/replay; actual stopped.
expected_actual.reconciliation_unavailable: Cannot validate staged bytes -> abort confirmed OPEN, stop; actual stopped, no commit/build.

results.evidence_is: SDK serialization and application behavior against declared synthetic service states.

recovery.upload: Never repeat uncertain upload. Read known OPEN transaction and exact transaction-view metadata/content; continue when bytes match. Unverifiable staged data stops and aborts only confirmed OPEN transaction.
recovery.commit: Before every attempt, read transaction and branch plus staged content. After lost reply, COMMITTED suppresses replay. OPEN with unchanged original branch and verified staged bytes permits at most second attempt. Other states stop.
recovery.build: FAILED/CANCELED stay unsuccessful. Read branch and retain RID for job review. Pending retains RID for later reads. Journal resume demonstrated no second Build.create.
recovery.unknown_creates: Recorded create/build intent without returned RID blocks replay; owner reconciliation required. Code guard exists; lost-create transport scenario not executed.
